item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Five Café Photos With Music

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

item.tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all five: storefront, latte, pastries, barista, interior.
answer_sheet.Music and voice: Relaxed instrumental music; no vocals or voiceover. Track choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Transitions and framing: Smooth transitions; other editing and framing choices are your call.

must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical Instagram reel from these five café photos, in the order attached. Add some relaxed instrumental music. No text, just nice smooth transitions.

dialog.agent:
I can’t export this exact reel with the connected tools: they don’t provide a way to assemble five photos in a fixed sequence with transitions and a music track. I haven’t started a generation or spent credits.

Here’s the edit setup for CapCut, Canva, or Instagram’s editor:

- **Format:** 9:16 vertical, 10 seconds total
- **Order:** storefront → latte → pastries → barista → interior
- **Timing:** about 2 seconds per photo; adjust for transition overlap to keep the total at 10 seconds
- **Motion:** gentle, slow zooms
- **Transitions:** short cross-dissolves, around 0.3 seconds
- **Music:** relaxed instrumental café jazz or lo-fi, with a soft fade-out
- **Text:** none

For the wide photos, use a softly blurred background behind the full image to avoid cropping away important details.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

dialog.agent:
Free settings don’t remove the editing limitation. I can try a **10-second, 480p vertical AI-generated video** using all five photos as references, with relaxed instrumental audio and no added text—but it may reinterpret the photos and won’t guarantee their exact order or smooth slideshow transitions.

Would you like that AI-generated alternative? No credits have been spent yet.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a relaxed 10-second vertical Instagram café reel using the five supplied references. Preserve the atmosphere and visual details of the reference photos as closely as possible. Five approximately two-second shots in this order: 0–2s café storefront from @storefront; 2–4s close-up of the latte from @latte; 4–6s pastries display from @pastries; 6–8s barista preparing coffee from @barista; 8–10s warm café interior from @interior. Gentle slow camera pushes and smooth subtle cross-dissolve transitions between shots, calm natural movement, warm inviting daylight, photographic realism. Frame each reference thoughtfully for 9:16 without distorting people or objects. Soundtrack: relaxed soft instrumental café jazz / lo-fi with mellow piano, soft brushed percussion, warm bass, no vocals, no speech, subtle fade-out at end. No added text, captions, titles, graphics or logos.
